description.value:
Moombas are cute bipedal/quadrupedal lion-like creatures with opposable thumbs, the final stage in the life cycle of a shumi.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Moombas gain +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma and -2 Intelligence.
  • Size: Moombas are Small creatures.
  • Type: Moombas are Monstrous Humanoid creatures with a moomba subtype.
  • Base Speed: Moombas have a base speed of 40 feet.
  • Languages: Moombas cannot fully speak any language, communicating through body language. They begin play understanding Common, and with high Intelligence may choose Undercommon or moogle.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Desert Runner: Moombas receive a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue and exhaustion.
  • Stability: Moombas receive a +4 racial bonus to their CMD when resisting bull rush or trip attempts while standing on the ground.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Choco / Mog buddies: Moombas gain a +4 bonus on Diplomacy, Bluff, Wild Empathy, and Ride checks with moogles/chocobos.
  • Prehensile Tail: Moombas can retrieve small, stowed objects as a swift action with their tail.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Bite: Moombas have a natural bite attack, dealing 1d3 points of damage.
  • Claws: Moombas receive two claw attacks that deal 1d3 points of damage.
  • Slapping Tail: Moombas have a tail attack of opportunity with 5-foot reach, dealing 1d4 plus Strength modifier.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Moombas have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Broken Language: Moombas take a -4 penalty on Diplomacy except against moombas, shumi, moogles, and chocobos.
  • Vocal Failure: Casting spells with vocal components requires a Linguistics check (DC 15 + double spell level) or the spell is lost.
